actions.apitable_create_record.descripti: Creates a new record in a datasheet.
actions.apitable_create_record.props.fie: Values for the new record. Blank fields are left empty.
actions.apitable_create_record.props.inf: Blank fields are left empty. Some column types, such as attachments and formulas, are not listed.
actions.apitable_create_record.props.spa: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_delete_record.descripti: Deletes one or more records from a datasheet.
actions.apitable_delete_record.props.rec: The IDs of the records to delete.
actions.apitable_delete_record.props.spa: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.field: Field names to include. Empty: every field.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.filte: Only records where this formula is true are returned.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.maxRe: Caps matching records before paging. Empty: no cap.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.pageN: Which page to return, starting at 1.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.recor: Only return these records. Empty: search all.
actions.apitable_find_record.props.space: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_get_datasheet_fields.de: Reads the field (column) definitions of a datasheet.
actions.apitable_get_datasheet_fields.pr: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_get_node_details.descri: Reads the details of a single file node, including its children.
The ID of the node to read.
The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_list_datasheets.descrip: Lists the datasheets available in a space.
actions.apitable_list_datasheets.props.s: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_list_spaces.description: Lists the spaces available to the authenticated account.
actions.apitable_list_views.description: Lists the views of a datasheet.
actions.apitable_list_views.props.space_: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_search_nodes.descriptio: Searches the file nodes (datasheets, folders, forms, dashboards, etc.) in a space.
actions.apitable_search_nodes.props.quer: Filter results to node names containing this text.
actions.apitable_search_nodes.props.spac: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_search_nodes.props.type: The type of node to search for.
actions.apitable_update_record.descripti: Updates an existing record in a datasheet.
actions.apitable_update_record.props.fie: Blank fields keep their value; unticked checkboxes are cleared.
actions.apitable_update_record.props.inf: Blank fields keep their current value; unticked checkboxes are cleared. Some column types, such as attachments and formulas, are not listed.
actions.apitable_update_record.props.rec: Map it from a trigger or a Find Records step.
actions.apitable_update_record.props.spa: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.apitable_upload_attachment.descr: Uploads a file to a datasheet and returns its storage URL.
actions.apitable_upload_attachment.props: The AITable workspace that holds your datasheet.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
auth.description:
To get your API token:
1. Sign in to AITable.
2. Click your avatar at the bottom left, then **My Settings**.
3. Open **Developer** and click **Generate new token**.
4. Copy the token and paste it below.
auth.props.apiTableUrl.description: Keep the default unless you self-host AITable.
auth.props.token.description: Generate it in AITable under My Settings → Developer.
